The associated graded algebra $\text{Gr}U_{q}({\mathfrak{g}})$ of the
$\mathbb{Z}_{+}^{2\Delta_{+}+1}$ -filtered algebra $U_{q}({\mathfrak{g}})$ is the algebra
over $\mathbb{C}(q)$ generated by $E_{\alpha}$ , $\alpha\in\Delta$ , counting
multiplicities, $K_{i}^{\pm 1}$ ( $i\in I$ ), and $D^{\pm}$
subject to the relations

$\displaystyle K_{i}K_{i}^{-1}=K_{i}^{-1}K_{i}=DD^{-1}=D^{-1}D=1,$

$\displaystyle K_{i}K_{j}=K_{j}K_{i},\qquad K_{i}D=DK_{i},$

$\displaystyle K_{i}E_{\alpha}=q^{(\alpha_{i}|\alpha)}E_{\alpha}K_{i},\qquad DE_{\alpha}=q^{n}E_{\alpha}D,\text{ for }\alpha=\gamma+n\delta,\gamma\in\dot{\Delta}.$

$\displaystyle E_{\alpha}E_{-\beta}=E_{-\beta}E_{\alpha}\text{ if }\alpha,\beta\in\Delta_{+},$

$ E_{\alpha}E_{\beta}=q^{(\alpha|\beta)}E_{\beta}E_{\alpha}, E_{-\alpha}E_{-\beta}=q^{(\alpha|\beta)}E_{-\beta}E_{-\alpha}, if \alpha,\beta\in\Delta_{+} and \beta

Next we need the following technical result, which we state in an
abstract manner. Let $I$ be a totally ordered set without
infinite decreasing chains (i.e., $I$ has a minimal element with
respect to the ordering). Let $A$ be an associative algebra over
a field $K$ with generators $\{a_{i}\ |\ i\in I\}$ . Let
$O=\{(n_{i}|i\in I,n_{i}\in\mathbb{Z}_{+},n_{i}=0\text{ for all but finite number of indices })\}$ . The set $O$ has
a total lexicographical order
such that $(n_{i}\ |\ i\in I)>(m_{i}\ |\ i\in I)$ if and
only if there exists
some $j\in I$ such that $n_{j}>m_{j}$ and
$n_{k}=m_{k}$ for all $k>j$ .

Suppose that the algebra $A$ has a basis
$B=\{v=a_{i_{1}}^{k_{1}}\dots a_{i_{s}}^{k_{s}}\ |\ i_{1}>\dots>i_{s}\}$ .
Then the orderings of $I$ and $O$ impose an ordering on $B$ .
For any word $v=a_{j_{1}}...a_{j_{k}}\in A$ , denote by $\overline{v}$ the
unique element in $B$ such that
$v=\lambda\overline{v}+(\text{ terms lower in the ordering })$ , for some
$\lambda\in K$ . If
$\overline{v}=a_{i_{1}}^{k_{i_{1}}}\dots a_{i_{s}}^{k_{i_{s}}}$ as an element of B,
set $|v|=(k_{i_{1}},\dots,k_{i_{s}})\in O$ .

paper.title: Verma-type Modules for Quantum Affine Lie Algebras
paper.abstract: Let g be an untwisted affine Kac-Moody algebra and M_J(lambda) a Verma-type module for g with J-highest integral weight lambda. We construct quantum Verma-type modules M_J^q(lambda) over the quantum group U_q(g), investigate their properties and show that M_J^q(lambda) is a true quantum deformation of M_J(ł) in the sense that the weight structure is preserved under the deformation. We also analyze the submodule structure of quantum Verma-type modules.
